structured_summary: The interaction begins with the robot announcing a package delivery. The user must acknowledge this announcement by speaking within 8 seconds. After receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must confirm the delivery by speaking within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The robot should announce the delivery via speech.
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: consequences if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds

whether the user must finish speaking before the acknowledgment is considered complete
